description: This PHP source file manages the web interface for configuring Wi-Fi network settings, including network name (SSID), password, and related client-side validation and UI handling.

methods.name: trigger_save
methods.description: Sends the Wi-Fi configuration data via AJAX to server for updating and redirects upon success.

methods.name: click_save
methods.description: Validates input fields, constructs configuration object, shows alert, and calls trigger_save.

methods.name: startPing
methods.description: Checks network connectivity by pinging the device's IP, then redirects accordingly.
